name: aether

name: pulsar
when_to_use: When post-P0 exploration must precede a plan revision, to test plan assumptions through hypothesis-first investigation

name: blazar
when_to_use: When a verified plan is ready to execute, to derive waves, dispatch every node, verify each landing, and integrate
